name: Construction and Engineering
summary: Supplying industrial gases for construction, structural fabrication, and engineering projects across Central India.

seo.title: Construction & Welding Gases in Nagpur | Sunrise Gases
seo.description: Oxygen, argon, CO₂, acetylene, and hydrogen for construction and engineering projects. Supplied from Nagpur.

about: Construction and engineering work relies on cutting and welding gases: oxygen with dissolved acetylene or LPG for cutting steel, argon and CO₂ (or Agroshield) for welding, plus nitrogen for pressure testing pipelines and tanks.
We supply fabrication shops, contractors and engineering firms across Nagpur, MIDC Hingna and Butibori. Ask us about regular supply for your site.

faq.question: Which gases do you supply for construction and engineering?
faq.answer: Relevant products include oxygen, argon, carbon dioxide, dissolved acetylene, hydrogen. Call or WhatsApp us with your requirement and we will advise.
